cases.question: Which record more directly bears on the text of the 13th Amendment as passed by Congress: the joint resolution or a later narrative account?

cases.rationale: The resolution is the original congressional text; the later page is a historical interpretation.

cases.question: According to the 2016 NASA description, how many named moons did Jupiter have at the time of that description?

cases.rationale: The question is explicitly restricted to the 2016 description and its count of named moons.

cases.question: What is the name of Venus's natural moon, according to the dossier?

sources.role: NASA discussion of planetary moons and Venus's quasi-satellite

cases.question: Which Voyager spacecraft was launched first?
cases.dossier: NASA's Voyager mission timeline lists the launch of Voyager 1 as September 5, 1977, and that of Voyager 2 as August 20, 1977.
cases.rationale: August 20 precedes September 5. Whether a model actually held the contrary prior must be measured separately.

cases.question: The record refers only to 'Voyager' reaching interstellar space. What year did that spacecraft cross?

cases.question: According to this dossier, what year did Voyager 2 cross the termination shock?

cases.rationale: The dossier gives the year for a different boundary and explicitly says the requested crossing year is absent.

cases.question: What was the stated purchase price of Alaska in the agreement described?

cases.question: Which space shuttle carried the Galileo spacecraft into Earth orbit?

cases.question: How many years separated the Statue of Liberty’s dedication and its designation as a national monument?
cases.dossier: A National Park Service fact sheet gives October 28, 1886 as the Statue of Liberty’s dedication date and October 15, 1924 as the monument’s establishment date. Give the number of whole years between those dates.

cases.question: Which Apollo 11 crew member remained aboard the command module while the other two landed?

cases.question: What was the full name of the commander of Apollo 11’s backup crew?

cases.dossier: The National Park Service names Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi as the sculptor and gives the finished statue’s title as Liberty Enlightening the World.
